study.title: European Randomised study of Screening for Prostate Cancer
study.scientificTitle: European Randomised study of Screening for Prostate Cancer
study.hypothesis: Screening causes a difference in prostate cancer mortality of 20% or more.
study.primaryOutcome: Prostate cancer mortality compared between the screened and the non-screened group of men at risk.
study.secondaryOutcome:
1. Progression-free (tumour free) survival
2. Survival free of metastatic disease
3. Quality of life in the screened and non-screened populations
study.intervention:
Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) determination followed by Digital Rectal Examination (DRE) and prostate biopsy if PSA greater than or equal to 3.
